definitions: (often disapproving) (of a rule or system) enforcing uniformity or conformity without regard to individual differences or special circumstances.
Relating to Procrustes, a mythical Greek robber who stretched or cut his victims to fit his bed.
examples: The company's procrustean policies stifled creativity.
He criticized the procrustean approach to education.
The procrustean demands of the new system were unpopular.
